# nRF54LM20-DK firmware v0.1.0

First firmware release for the nRF54LM20-DK: a matched Channel Sounding
initiator/reflector pair in RAS and IPT modes.

## Supported hardware

- **nRF54LM20-DK** (PCA10184), target `nrf54lm20dk/nrf54lm20a/cpuapp`.
- Built as the **A** variant (`nRF54LM20A`), the NPU-less variant for the
  B-silicon DK (`SOC_NRF54LM20A_DEVELOP_IN_NRF54LM20B`). The firmware does not
  use the NPU, so the A target runs on both silicon flavors.
- One 2.4 GHz trace antenna and one RF path; no antenna switch and no RF
  supply rail.
- COBS ranging stream on **VCOM0** (`uart30`) at **1,000,000 baud**, 8N1, no
  flow control.
- Console on **VCOM1** (`uart20`) at **115200 baud**.

## Firmware variants

`cs-ranging-firmware.zip` contains four images:

| File | Role | Mode | Preset |
|------|------|------|--------|
| `initiator_nrf54lm20dk_cent_a1_1.hex` | Initiator | RAS | `nrf54lm20dk_cent_a1_1` |
| `reflector_nrf54lm20dk_peri_a1_1.hex` | Reflector | RAS | `nrf54lm20dk_peri_a1_1` |
| `initiator_nrf54lm20dk_cent_a1_1_ipt.hex` | Initiator | IPT | `nrf54lm20dk_cent_a1_1_ipt` |
| `reflector_nrf54lm20dk_peri_a1_1_ipt.hex` | Reflector | IPT | `nrf54lm20dk_peri_a1_1_ipt` |

Flash a **matched pair**: RAS initiator with RAS reflector, or IPT initiator
with IPT reflector. The two modes use different BLE discovery and do not pair
with each other.

## Install

1. Download `cs-ranging-firmware.zip` from this release.
2. Flash one DK with the initiator image and one with the reflector image.
3. Open the initiator's VCOM0 at 1,000,000 baud for the COBS stream; use
   VCOM1 at 115200 for the console.

See the
[flash quickstart](https://github.com/Metirionic/mars-cs-nrf54lm/blob/v0.1.0/docs/flash-quickstart.md)
for the full procedure, and the
[hardware reference](https://github.com/Metirionic/mars-cs-nrf54lm/blob/v0.1.0/docs/hardware.md)
for the VCOM mapping, presets, and board-support contract.

## Known issues

- **Do not open the COBS port at 921600.** The DK's J-Link VCOM bridge supports
  up to 1 Mbps and explicitly does not support 921600; the firmware uses
  1,000,000 baud.
- The **A target is emulated**: `nRF54LM20A` is the NPU-less variant built for
  the B-silicon DK.
- The bench validation boards are **engineering-sample A silicon**
  (`nRF54LM20A ENGA`).
- **One antenna, one RF path.** Multi-antenna and multi-path presets are not
  applicable to the DK; the firmware deliberately has no antenna-switch or
  RF-supply nodes.
- COBS decoding uses the
  [mars-bluetooth-hci](https://github.com/Metirionic/mars-bluetooth-hci) wire
  format.
